Chapter 547 - 547 The School's Self-Inspection; Announcement!

547 The School’s Self-Inspection; Announcement!

The Song family.

Ever since Lin Fan gave the Song family the recipe for the new herbal tea, the sales of Song Herbal Tea started to increase day by day. It had the momentum of becoming the number-one beverage in the country.

The entire Song family also began to become busy. They were expanding the market and growth line.

Originally, the Song family wanted to wait for Song Jiaxin to graduate and open a random company for her to train.

Then, she would come to manage the entire Song Herbal Tea.

However, as the Song family became busier and busier…The Song family changed their decision.

Of course, the most important thing was that Song Jiaxin was Lin Fan’s classmate. Moreover, their relationship was not ordinary.

In this situation, they had to give Song Jiaxin the power she needed as soon as possible.

As a result, on the first day of school, Song Jiaxin did not report to school as she was dealing with company matters.

Today, she dragged her tired body back to the villa at night and took an extremely comfortable hot bath.

Then, Song Jiaxin sat in front of the window sill, picked up her phone, and started to browse.

It was only at this time of the day that she had a little entertainment time of her own.

Tired and fulfilling!

Song Jiaxin opened Weibo out of habit.

Soon, her gaze fell on the top trending topic—Jiangbei University Thief.

Song Jiaxin frowned.

She was naturally disgusted by thieves.

She did not expect such a person to appear in her school.

With a hint of anger, she clicked on the topic.

In the next moment…

Song Jiaxin frowned even more.

The back view of the man in the gray T-shirt!

With just a glance, she could confirm that this person was Lin Fan.

Lin Fan stole someone else’s wallet?

How was this possible?

Song Jiaxin instantly understood that this was a false accusation!

She had seen many similar things.

Most of the time, even if it was proven that the person was framed, the slanderers would only receive a little criticism.

Meanwhile, the victim would be deeply affected.

However, the other party actually dared to frame Lin Fan!?

Song Jiaxin’s face instantly turned cold. She opened her contact list, found Black 001, and dialed the number.

The internet was one of the most important parts of any enterprise.

It involved important information such as accounts, operations, and planning.

Therefore, many large enterprises had their own hackers to stop and conquer their enemies.

Hacker 001 was Song Herbal Tea’s most powerful hacker.

“Hello, Ms. Song.” A slightly hoarse voice came from the phone.

Song Jiaxin said, “Help me investigate the surveillance cameras of Jiangbei University. I want footage that’s related to the thief in Jiangbei University, as well as other related information!”

“Yes, please wait a moment,” the hoarse voice said.

A moment later, a compressed file appeared on her computer desktop.

Song Jiaxin quickly felt relieved. It turned out that Tang Yuan and Lin Fan met for the first time at the registration office, and then they met for the second time at the field. That was where Tang Yuan took a photo…

Then, Tang Yuan first posted the message on his WeChat Moments before posting it on Weibo to frame Lin Fan. He even hired fake commenters.

The more Song Jiaxin read the information, the colder her expression became.

“How vicious! Hmph!”

Then, she dialed the number of the public relations department.

“Help me post a video and an article. I want it to enter the top of the trending list in the shortest time possible!”

“Got it!” A solemn tone came from the phone.

…

Jiangbei University.

Director Huang of the Academic Affairs Office, Professor Wang of the School of Computer Science, Director Liu of the Security Department, and the others were all gathered together.

“Director Huang, the school’s surveillance footage is all here.”

“Thank you for your hard work,” said Director Huang.

Then, he said to the bald middle-aged man beside him, “Professor Wang, I’m sorry to trouble you.”

“It’s just a small matter,” said Professor Wang.

After saying that, he sat in front of the computer and prepared to copy the surveillance video.

At this moment, Professor Wang said, “Huh? The surveillance footage seems to have been hacked.”

“Someone has hacked in and forced me out.” Director Huang frowned slightly.

The location of this particular surveillance camera was not a private location.

However, it was also troublesome if the hacker was someone with evil intentions.

Director Liu obviously realized this and asked, “When was it hacked?”

“Today, just now…” Professor Wang said. “However, you don’t have to be too nervous. The other party only hacked into today’s surveillance cameras and only copied the footage.”

When Director Huang and Director Liu heard this, they both heaved a sigh of relief.

If it was just today, it should not have had too much of an impact.

Professor Wang did not say anything else. His hands were jumping on the keyboard.

Then, he quickly compared the back view of the thief from Jiangbei University with the surveillance footage.

It had to be said that knowledge had an extremely magical ability.

It would have taken hours to get the information.

In less than ten seconds, the front, side, and back of the man in the gray T-shirt and Tang Yuan appeared on the screen.

“I’ve already found out,” said Professor Wang.

Then, the three of them looked at the screen.

The next moment, Director Huang, Professor Wang, and Director Liu widened their eyes and shouted, “What?”

Lin Fan!

The thief Tang Yuan was talking about was Lin Fan?

“Nonsense!” Director Huang was the first to break out of her mouth. “Slander!”

“The moral values of the world are declining day by day, and the hearts of the people are no longer what they used to be! Does he think he can spout nonsense on the internet? That’s simply unreasonable!”

“How vicious!” Director Liu exclaimed.

According to their initial thoughts, after checking the surveillance video, even if they found out that the other party did not secretly pick up a wallet, they would find him and interrogate him in detail.

Now, there was no need!

It was completely unnecessary!

Who was Lin Fan?

He was a mathematician who had solved several unsolved mathematical problems, a super scholar who invented the earthquake prediction device, the carbon-based photolithographic machine, the super battery, and the human islet recovery drug!

This time, he even won the Fields Medal and four Nobel Prizes!

That was right!

He was enough to be called a great existence!

Now, someone actually said that he was a thief?

How was this possible?

“Director Huang, I think the school must handle this matter properly. Otherwise, I’m afraid a great scholar like Professor Lin will be wronged!” Professor Wang said seriously.

“I’ll report this to the school now and deal with this matter in the strictest and swiftest way possible. I’ll try my best to reduce the grievances Professor Lin has suffered!” Director Huang said solemnly.

That night, the chancellor, vice-chancellor, director of academic affairs, director of education, and many other high-ranking officials of Jiangbei University held an emergency meeting.

Generally speaking, in order to ensure the accuracy of the information, it would take at least three days of investigation before it was announced.

However…

Before dawn the next day, Jiangbei University started behaving strangely… They released an investigation notice regarding the thief at Jiangbei University.
